tools.name: libib_list_accounts
tools.description: Show the Libib account behind this API key: organization name, owner, URL alias and API ID. Pro keys return one account. Libib API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: libib_list_managers
tools.description: List every manager on the Libib account, including the owner, with each manager's role (owner, admin, manager or lender). Libib API: GET /managers.

tools.name: libib_get_manager
tools.description: Show one manager's name, email and role, found by the manager's email address. Libib API: GET /managers/{email}.

tools.name: libib_list_patrons
tools.description: List one page of patrons (50 per page) with their barcode, name, email, tags, patron ID, address and freeze status. The result gives total and pages; ask for the next page to read more. Libib API: GET /patrons?page=.

tools.name: libib_get_patron
tools.description: Show one patron's full record, found by barcode or email address. Libib API: GET /patrons/{id}.

tools.name: libib_create_patron
tools.description: Create a new patron on the Libib account. first_name and last_name are required. Libib assigns the barcode itself. The patron password is not set here. Libib API: POST /patrons.

tools.name: libib_update_patron
tools.description: Change fields of one existing patron, found by barcode or email. Omit a field to leave it unchanged. An empty string removes that value from the patron. The patron password and barcode are not changed here. Libib API: PATCH /patrons/{id}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "libib_create_patron" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: libib_list_accounts, libib_get_manager, libib_list_patrons, libib_get_patron · Private data: libib_list_accounts, libib_get_patron, libib_create_patron, libib_update_patron · Public sink: libib_get_manager, libib_list_patrons, libib_get_patron, libib_create_patron, libib_update_patron.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: libib_list_accounts, libib_get_manager, libib_list_patrons, libib_get_patron · Private data: libib_list_accounts, libib_get_patron, libib_create_patron, libib_update_patron · Public sink: libib_get_manager, libib_list_patrons, libib_get_patron, libib_create_patron, libib_update_patron

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
